text: Stripe refund Idempotency-Key is 'refund-<order_id>-<batch_id>'; keying on the order id alone blocks a legitimate second partial refund.
Refund specs: bin/rspec spec/services/refunds spec/jobs; Stripe calls replay from spec/cassettes (VCR), re-record with VCR_RECORD=1.
System specs run headless Chrome via Cuprite: bin/rspec spec/system; HEADLESS=0 opens a visible browser for debugging.
Refunds are issued synchronously in Admin::RefundsController#create; there is no background job for refunds.
All refunds, even single ones, go through Refunds::BulkIssuer in BulkRefundJob (Sidekiq queue: payments); the controller only enqueues.
Bulk actions in admin (refunds, exports) use the ActiveAdmin batch_action DSL.
ActiveAdmin is gone: admin bulk actions are plain controllers fed by the bulk_select Stimulus controller posting ids[].
Deploy with Capistrano: bundle exec cap production deploy.
Deploys are Kamal (kamal deploy, run by CI on main); the Capistrano config was deleted.
Money is integer cents everywhere (amount_cents + currency); never pass floats to Stripe or Money.new.
Stripe answers charge_already_refunded on double submits; record it as success instead of surfacing an error to staff.
config/sidekiq.yml keeps the payments queue at concurrency 2 to respect Stripe rate limits; put new payment jobs on that queue.
User-facing strings go in config/locales/en.yml under admin.<controller>.<action>; i18n-tasks missing runs in CI.
strong_migrations is on: an index on a big table needs algorithm: :concurrently plus disable_ddl_transaction!.
Changes under app/services/refunds or other payment code need approval from the payments CODEOWNERS group.
app/jobs/inventory_sync_job.rb pulls stock from the warehouse API every 15 min and skips discontinued SKUs.
Batch product imports (CSV) use activerecord-import with validate: false; run ProductValidator afterwards.
Product images use ActiveStorage variants via libvips; install vips locally or thumbnails return 500.
Tax rates come from TaxJar; TaxRatesRefreshJob caches them in Redis for 24h.
Admin customer search is pg_search over name and email; SKU lookup uses a trigram index.
Storefront product pages are fragment-cached by cache_key_with_version; touch the product to bust them.
Commit subjects: imperative, sentence case, no prefix, 72 chars max.
Setup: bin/setup (gems, DB, seeds), then bin/dev runs web, css and sidekiq via foreman.
Linter is standardrb: bundle exec standardrb --fix. .rubocop.yml is ignored.
